business_summary: Redsun Services Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides community services in China. The company offers property management services, such as order maintenance, security, cleaning, greening and gardening, facility management, and repairs and maintenance; manages residential, commercial, and other properties; and provides property management services to shopping malls, home improvement and furnishings malls, hotels and theme parks, office buildings, and schools. It also provides value-added services to non-property owners, including consulting services to other property management companies; preliminary planning and design consultancy services to property developers for property development projects; and sales assistance services to property developers at property sales venues and display units, including visitor reception, cleaning, security inspection, and maintenance. In addition, the company offers community value-added services, including property brokerage, property decoration, community convenience services, common area value-added services, intelligent services, retail services, home decoration services, and asset management services. Further, it provides software maintenance, information system integration, construction and installation, consulting, asset operation, and pension services, as well as engages in the wholesale business. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China. Redsun Services Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of Redsun Services Group (Holdings) Limited.
